text: Choose models for the decision at hand.

Functional architecture describes the work a system needs to perform. Physical architecture describes the items and links intended to perform it. A model represents selected aspects of reality; a simulation explores what that representation predicts under chosen conditions. Model-based practice connects models with requirements and evidence so changes can be traced.

items: Illustration: Evaluate alternative platform arrangements to understand a possible speed-and-protection trade-off before committing to a purchase.

text: Make a model no more elaborate than the decision requires, and state what it cannot demonstrate.
A tidy diagram is not proof that its assumptions match reality.
